title: krateo-azure-aso
description: Azure Service Operator v2, wrapped for Krateo. Values are forwarded to the upstream azure-service-operator chart.

azure-service-operator.description: Forwarded verbatim to the upstream chart; keys not listed here keep the upstream default.

azureTenantID.description: Entra tenant ID for the operator's default identity.

azureClientID.description: Client (application) ID of the operator's identity.

azureClientSecret.description: Client secret. Prefer useWorkloadIdentityAuth, or an externally managed Secret.

useWorkloadIdentityAuth.description: Authenticate as a federated workload identity instead of a client secret.

createAzureOperatorSecret.description: Create aso-controller-settings from the values above.

installCRDs.description: Let the operator install and manage its resource CRDs. ASO does this at runtime, which is why no -crds chart ships here.

crdPattern.description: Semicolon-delimited CRD globs to install. EMPTY INSTALLS NOTHING on a fresh install; use '*' for all 293 or scope to the groups you need.

azureTargetNamespaces.description: Namespaces to watch. Empty watches the whole cluster.
